title: Total RNA Isolation and Quality Analysis for Bulk RNA-seq
author: Jianmin Xue
materials: Denature for 5 minutes at 70°C in heat block (tubes) or thermocycler with no heated lid (plates). After denaturing, place on ice for a full 5 minutes, then spin down. During bioanalyzer chip loading, the samples should remain on ice. Note: This step is critical to keep the product ‘snapped’ in position after the sample has been denatured.
Wait 30 seconds, then release the clip.

steps.title: Tissue Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Lyse the tissue and homogenize the sample using a QIAshredder column.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μl of RLT Plus buffer to 5 mg of pulverized tissue.
Pipet the lysate into a QIAshredder spin column in a 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge for 2 min at maximum speed.

steps.title: Genomic DNA Removal
steps.instruction: Remove gDNA from the lysate using a gDNA Eliminator column.

substeps.instruction: Pipet the liquid from the QIAshredder collection tube and transfer it to a gDNA Eliminator spin column in a 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge for 30 s at 8000xg.
Discard the column and save the flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Binding and Initial Wash
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for RNA binding and perform the first wash.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of 70% ethanol to the flow-through and mix well by pipetting (do not centrifuge).
Transfer up to 700 μl of the sample (including any precipitate) to an RNeasy spin column in a 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge for 15 s at 8000xg and discard the flow-through.
Add 700 μl Buffer RW1 to the RNeasy spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at 8000xg and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Column Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNeasy spin column membrane to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl Buffer RPE to the RNeasy spin column.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 8000xg.
Add another 500 μl Buffer RPE to the RNeasy spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at 8000xg and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Elution and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Dry the membrane and elute the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Place the RNeasy spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube and centrifuge at full speed for 1 min.
Place the column in another new collection tube.
Add 40 μl RNase-free water directly to the membrane.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 8000xg to elute the RNA.
Aliquot the purified sample into 10 μl aliquots, separating 2 μl for quality assessment.

steps.title: Bioanalyzer Setup: Gel and Ladder Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the RNA 6000 Nano gel and ladder aliquots (performed upon first use of kit).

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate RNA gel matrix (red vial) to room temperature for 30 min.
Pipette 550 µl of RNA 6000 Nano gel mix into an RNA 6000 spin filter and centrifuge at 4000 g for 10 minutes.
Aliquot 65 µl of filtered gel into 0.5 ml RNase-free microfuge tubes; store at 4°C (use within 4 weeks).
Thaw RNA 6000 ladder tube at room temperature for 5 minutes, vortex, and transfer 35 µl into a 0.65 ml tube.
Heat denature ladder at 70°C for 2 minutes, then immediately transfer to ice for 5 minutes.
Dispense 2.2 µl aliquots into 0.65 ml tubes and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Bioanalyzer Setup: Electrode Cleaning
steps.instruction: Clean the Bioanalyzer electrodes using a cleaner chip.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 350 µl of nuclease-free water into a labeled electrode cleaner chip.
Place the chip inside the bioanalyzer, close the lid, and ensure software acknowledges the chip.
After one minute, remove the chip and wait 10 seconds for water to evaporate.

steps.title: Gel-Dye Mix Preparation
steps.instruction: Combine the filtered gel with the Nano dye concentrate.

substeps.instruction: Allow RNA 6000 Nano dye concentrate (blue vial) and RNA gel aliquot to reach room temperature for 30 minutes (protect dye from light).
Vortex dye concentrate for 10 seconds and spin down.
Add 1.0 µl dye concentrate to a 65 µl aliquot of filtered gel.
Vortex and spin the tube at 13000 rcf for 10 minutes at room temperature (protect from light).

steps.title: Sample and Chip Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare samples and prime the Bioanalyzer chip.

substeps.instruction: Thaw sample tubes from -80°C on ice and spin down.
Remove plate seal and cover with a 96-well rubber mat.
Remove a ladder aliquot from -80°C and keep on ice.
Set chip priming station base plate to position 'C' and plunger to the topmost position.
Add 9.0 µl gel dye mix to the well marked 'G' inside a black circle.
Place chip in priming station, close, and press plunger until the clip holds it.
Wait 5 seconds for the plunger to rise, then slowly pull it up to the 1 ml position.
Verify capillaries are no longer visible on the underside of the chip; repeat or replace chip if necessary.

steps.title: Chip Loading
steps.instruction: Load the remaining reagents and RNA samples into the chip.

substeps.instruction: Add 9.0 µl gel-dye mix to the two other wells marked 'G'.
Add 5.0 µl RNA 6000 marker to the ladder well and 12 sample wells.
Add 1.0 µl RNA 6000 ladder to the well marked by a ladder picture.
Add 1.0 µl of denatured RNA sample into each of the sample wells.
Vortex the chip at 2200 rpm for one minute.

steps.title: Bioanalyzer Run and Data Entry
steps.instruction: Execute the analysis on the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer.

substeps.instruction: Run the chip within 5 minutes of loading.
Open 2100 Expert program, place chip inside, and close the lid.
Under 'Instrument', select 'Eukaryote Total RNA Nano Series II' for Assay Selection.
Enter the file prefix as 'BA_YYMMDD_NN_sample' and click 'Start'.
Under 'Data' > 'Chip Summary', enter sample information as 'sample_YYMMDD_PP_RCC'.
View results via 'Gel' and 'Electropherogram' tabs.

steps.title: Post-Run Cleanup
steps.instruction: Dispose of materials and clean the instrument.

substeps.instruction: Remove and dispose of the LabChip after the run.
Clean electrodes with the electrode cleaner chip.
Empty electrode cleaner chips at the end of the day.
